title: Audio comparison
responsibility: Summarizes two related recordings as one gallery card while keeping their statuses separate.

inputs.name: AudioComparison.before
inputs.description: Required original recording whose identity preserves its gallery anchor. Missing flag or empty file marks its side unavailable.

inputs.name: AudioComparison.after
inputs.description: Required updated recording supplying the card title, category and main anchor. Missing flag or empty file marks its side unavailable.

inputs.name: AudioComparison.onopen
inputs.description: Required callback for opening the comparison viewer. Its button is disabled until mount completes.

outputs.name: AudioComparison
outputs.description: Paired-audio card with independent before/after badges and positive finite duration labels. Unavailable sides show not-proven. Does not create a combined passing result or play audio itself.
